include_schemas.title: Include Schemas
include_schemas.description: If non-empty, only objects in these schemas will be included.

exclude_schemas.title: Exclude Schemas
exclude_schemas.description: Schemas to exclude (applied after include_schemas filter).

include_object_types.title: Include Object Types
include_object_types.description: Which catalog object types to include in the dictionary.

concurrency_objects.title: Object Fan-out Concurrency
concurrency_objects.description: Maximum number of tables/views to process in parallel.

concurrency_columns.title: Column Fan-out Concurrency
concurrency_columns.description: Maximum number of columns to profile in parallel per object (if column profiling fan-out is enabled).

max_columns_profiled_per_object.title: Max Columns Profiled Per Object
max_columns_profiled_per_object.description: If an object has more columns than this limit, only a heuristic subset is profiled; otherwise all columns are profiled.

sample_rows_per_object.title: Sample Rows Per Object
sample_rows_per_object.description: Number of sample rows to retrieve/profile per table/view (unless strict_no_sample_values is true).

top_values_per_column.title: Top Values Per Column
top_values_per_column.description: Number of top/frequent values to compute per column during profiling.

strict_no_sample_values.title: Strict No Sample Values
strict_no_sample_values.description: If true, do not retrieve or pass through raw sample values; only include aggregate statistics.

domain_glossary.title: Domain Glossary
domain_glossary.description: Free-text glossary and notes (acronyms, domain terms, known entities) to improve descriptions.

allOf.description: Include/exclude schema lists should not overlap.
